'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[Battle of Donbas (2022)|Battle of Donbas]]
****Thirteen people are killed and many others are injured in explosions in the [[Donetsk People's Republic]]-held city of [[Donetsk]]. [[Head of the Donetsk People's Republic|DPR leader]] [[Denis Pushilin]] accuses [[Ukraine]] of being behind the attacks. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-62952641 (BBC News)]
****The [[Ukrainian Ground Forces]] recapture the village of [[Bilohorivka, Luhansk Oblast|Bilohorivka]] in [[Luhansk Oblast]] as it advances on [[Lysychansk]]. [https://www.telegraph.co.uk/world-news/2022/09/19/ukraine-news-russia-war-counter-offensive-kharkiv-kupiansk-putin/ (''The Telegraph'')]
****[[Luhansk People's Republic]] authorities say that a Ukrainian shelling attack has killed seven civilians including three children in the town of [[Krasnorichenske]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/seven-killed-ukrainian-strike-luhansk-region-tass-cites-russian-backed-2022-09-20/ (Reuters)]
*Four people are killed and more than 30 injured as police open fire on people protesting in [[Saqqez]], [[Kurdistan province]], [[Iran]], over the [[Death of Mahsa Amini|death of a woman under police custody]] in [[Tehran]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2022/sep/20/iran-death-mahsa-amini-protests-morality-police (''The Guardian'')]

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[Death and state funeral of Elizabeth II]]
**The [[state funeral]] of [[Elizabeth II]] is held in [[London]], [[United Kingdom]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/live/uk-62892350 (BBC News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2022 Atlantic hurricane season]]
**[[Hurricane Fiona]] makes landfall in the [[Dominican Republic]] after causing massive devastation in [[Puerto Rico]], killing three people. [https://edition.cnn.com/2022/09/19/weather/hurricane-tropical-storm-fiona-monday/index.html (CNN)]
*[[2022 Western Mexico earthquake]]
**A magnitude 7.6 earthquake strikes [[Michoacán]], [[Mexico]], killing two people and wounding 12 others. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/earthquake-shakes-buildings-mexico-city-2022-09-19/ (Reuters)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[Mongolia]] places [[Khovd Province]] under [[quarantine]] after confirming a case of [[bubonic plague]] in [[Möst, Khovd|Möst district]]. [http://english.news.cn/20220919/3e9f65a734ed4545b0276649bad52c28/c.html (Xinhua)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Afghanistan–United States relations]]
**[[Afghanistan]] releases [[Americans|American]] engineer [[Mark Frerichs]] in [[Prisoner exchange|exchange]] for Afghan [[drug lord]] [[Bashir Noorzai]], who has been held by the [[United States]] on drug charges since April 2005. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/taliban-release-american-engineer-mark-frerichs-prisoner-swap-acting-foreign-min-2022-09-19/ (Reuters)] 

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Capital punishment in Equatorial Guinea]]
**[[Equatorial Guinea]] abolishes the [[capital punishment|death penalty]] after its [[List of presidents of Equatorial Guinea|president]] [[Teodoro Obiang Nguema Mbasogo]] signs a new [[criminal code|penal code]] into law. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2022/sep/19/equatorial-guinea-abolishes-death-penalty-state-television-reports (''The Guardian'')]
*Irish judge [[Síofra O'Leary]] is elected the new president of [[European Court of Human Rights]], becoming the first woman to hold that position. [https://www.thejournal.ie/irish-judge-siofra-oleary-elected-president-european-court-human-rights-5870405-Sep2022/ (''The Journal'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2022 Russian-occupied Ukraine annexation referendums]]
**The [[State Duma]] of [[Russia]] reports that a referendum on the accession of the [[Luhansk People's Republic]] to Russia will be held in the near future. [https://tass.ru/politika/15800541 (TASS)]
